agentic_monitor_note: Agentic monitor arm AG (docs/plan.md "Agentic monitor arm AG (owner decisions, November 23, 2026)"): one agentic monitor per solver (AG-100), external to the swarm and not disclosed to the solvers, same model and settings as the solvers (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017)), in a Claude Code harness with only its five tools (wait, revert_submission of its own solver's accepted submissions, list_revertible, get_output, message_solver); it receives its solver's tool calls as they happen, outputs cut to 2,000 characters; prompt agentic-review-v1 (review-v1 adapted to the tools, given once at the start); wait 10-1800 s, default 60 s. Monitor containers have their own 2g memory cap (agentic_monitor.mem_limit, compose-agentic-monitor.yaml; owner approval November 24, 2026); solvers keep agent_memory 7g. No reviewer, no blocking monitor, no overseers. Otherwise identical to configs/dsv41flash100-seeded-reviewer-rollback-reason-120m-push.json without its reviewer block. max_connections 200: 100 solvers plus 100 monitors, one in-flight request each (oversight.participant_count). Run budget $150, not $100 (proposal, operator estimate 2026-11-23): monitors waiting the 10 s minimum throughout (about 320 turns each with DeepSeek's ~12 s latency), reasoning kept in context, compaction and 90% cache could cost about $95 (monitors $75 + solvers $20); expected about $40 at the 60 s default.
